environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct TCP passthrough on port 443. Instance runs in a private subnet with NAT gateway egress. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection or filtering layer between client and application. Flask served via gunicorn with 4 workers.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough, no TLS termination at LB
config.compute: EC2 t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2023, private subnet
config.tls: terminated at application via nginx sidecar, no request filtering
